title: French Beans with Mint

media.caption: Trimming the ends of the green beans
Sautéing in a pan with onions and oil

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Fibre
healthBenefits.text: Green beans provide a good amount of dietary fibre, supporting digestion and helping maintain healthy blood sugar levels.

healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: Lemon juice adds a strong dose of vitamin C, supporting immune function and skin health.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil contributes monounsaturated fats that help support healthy cholesterol levels.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Support
healthBenefits.text: Onions contain quercetin and other antioxidants that help reduce inflammation and oxidative stress.

healthBenefits.title: Digestive Aid
healthBenefits.text: Fresh mint or thyme can help soothe digestion and add antimicrobial properties to the dish.

healthBenefits.title: Low-Calorie, Nutrient-Dense
healthBenefits.text: This dish is naturally low in calories while providing vitamins A, C, and K, making it a nutritious side option.

_ingredientsText:
1 Kg of green beans
• 1 onion, chopped
• 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped
• 1 1⁄2 tablespoons bread crumbs
• 1 tablespoon chopped mint or thyme
• juice of 1 lemon
• 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
• salt
• pepper (optional)
_preparationText:
1. Fagiolini
2.ingredienti
3.pulizia delle estremità dei fagiolini
4. bollitura
5. scolare l'acqua
6.saltare in padella con cipolle e olio
7.aggiunta di pangrattato e prezzemolo
8.aggiunta di succo di limone
